# ESPCN-x4

Super Resolution · `espcn-x4_17x17` · DX-APP Python example

Super Resolution model, evaluated on BSD100.

**Input** 17 × 17 × 1 · **Dataset** BSD100 · **License** Apache-2.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![ESPCN-x4 output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models ESPCN_X4
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/super_resolution/espcn/espcn-x4_17x17/espcn-x4_17x17_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/espcn-x4_17x17.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_lowres275x150.png
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target espcn-x4_17x17_sync   # once
./bin/espcn-x4_17x17_sync \
  -m assets/models/espcn-x4_17x17.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_lowres275x150.png
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | PSNR | SSIM |
|---|---:|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 28.83 | 0.78 |
| Q-Lite | 25.51 (−3.32) | 0.73 (−0.05) |
| Q-Pro | 20.33 (−8.50) | 0.42 (−0.36) |

BSD100 · difference vs Raw in brackets.

> **Note:** Q-Pro is 8.50 points below Raw on PSNR.
